user.title: Suptronics X120X UPS
user.description: Connect to the UPS HAT on this Raspberry Pi. The defaults match the stock wiring of every X12xx board.

data_description.model: Only the name and the product link shown on the device. Every X12xx board is read the same way.
data_description.i2c_bus: Bus 1 is the 40-pin header on every Raspberry Pi model.
data_description.i2c_address: Decimal or hexadecimal. The MAX17040-family gauge answers at 0x36.
data_description.pld_pin: BCM numbering. High means mains power is present.
data_description.chg_pin: BCM numbering. Used to stop the pack from charging.
data_description.gpiochip: Leave empty to detect the header chip automatically.

error.invalid_address: Not a valid I2C address. Use something like 0x36.
error.duplicate_pin: The two GPIO pins must be different.
error.i2c_error: The fuel gauge did not answer. Check that I2C is enabled and that the bus and address are correct.
error.gpio_error: The GPIO lines could not be claimed. Check the pin numbers and that no other process is holding them.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

data_description.low_battery_threshold: Turns the Battery low sensor on below this capacity.
data_description.pld_bias: Leave on pull-up unless the AC power sensor reads the wrong way round.
